name: Zofia Lewandowska
bio:
Zofia's passion for aerodynamics ignited during her engineering studies at Warsaw University of Technology, where she excelled in fluid dynamics. Her motorsport journey began with an internship at a small racing outfit, where she quickly proved her aptitude for optimizing downforce and reducing drag. After several years honing her skills, she joined Carlin, drawn by their commitment to nurturing young talent and pushing technical boundaries.

As Head of Aero, Zofia is known for her meticulous approach to data analysis and her ability to translate complex simulations into tangible improvements on the track. She believes that a strong aerodynamic package is the cornerstone of any successful racing team, and she's driven to create innovative solutions that give her team a competitive edge. Her dedication to precision and her tireless work ethic have made her an invaluable asset to Carlin.

Zofia's leadership style is characterized by a collaborative approach. She makes sure all opinions are heard and every engineer feels that they are a part of a team. She's a great addition to any racing team.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair often tied back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: Zofia is of average height with a focused expression, always seeming deep in thought.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic calculations and sketches.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when concentrating on complex problems.
Prefers working late at night when the workshop is quiet and free from distractions.
